question.text: An observer looks at a distant tree of height <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> with a telescope of magnifying power of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math>. To the observer, the tree appears as

solution.text: Angular magnification of the telescope is 20 so now the tree will subtend a larger angle at the observer's eye and hence appears 20 times nearer
